question: Who insures exporters and overseas investors against nonpayment or seizure?
answer: Four kinds of risk bearer, in the study's map. For exporters: a private trade-credit insurer, which insures commercial or political nonpayment within limits and conditions, and EXIM export-credit insurance, which covers a stated share of eligible foreign-receivable nonpayment. For overseas investors: DFC political-risk insurance, which covers selected inconvertibility, expropriation, violence and contract risks, and the World Bank Group's MIGA guarantee and risk-sharing facility, which covers qualifying cross-border financing and may share first loss with donor or IDA resources. Export-credit insurance protects an exporter or lender against defined nonpayment. Political-risk insurance protects a qualifying investment or financing against named government or conflict risks. Neither makes the buyer's debt disappear, guarantees a country's currency value, covers physical cargo loss by default, or authorizes a transaction prohibited by sanctions.

items.title: The underlying trade obligation remains primary
items.sub: Trade, Export Credit and Political-Risk Control Map
items.text: Open-account terms create a receivable owed by the foreign buyer. Documentary collection, letter of credit, factoring and export-credit insurance allocate different risks and use different payment channels. ECI ordinarily covers commercial risks such as insolvency or protracted default and selected political risks; it does not ordinarily insure physical loss of the shipped goods.
kv: TRADE_EXPORT_CREDIT_AND_POLITICAL_RISK_CONTROL_MAP_2026-10-01.md, section “1. The underlying trade obligation remains primary”

items.title: EXIM is a federal risk bearer with policy conditions
items.sub: Trade, Export Credit and Political-Risk Control Map
items.text: The Export-Import Bank of the United States offers export-credit insurance for U.S. exporters' eligible foreign receivables. Its public description separates agreement on credit terms, shipment and invoice, shipment reporting and premium, buyer payment, and an EXIM claim after nonpayment. Coverage can be less than the invoice amount; policy compliance, export proof, credit limits, overdue-buyer rules and filing deadlines matter. EXIM authority, board authorization, issued policy, reported shipment, accepted claim and federal payment are separate clocks. A country limitation schedule shows whether support may be available under current terms; it is not a commitment to a transaction.
kv: TRADE_EXPORT_CREDIT_AND_POLITICAL_RISK_CONTROL_MAP_2026-10-01.md, section “2. EXIM is a federal risk bearer with policy conditions”

items.title: DFC covers investment political risk
items.sub: Trade, Export Credit and Political-Risk Control Map
items.text: The U.S. International Development Finance Corporation offers political-risk insurance for qualifying overseas investments, including risks such as currency inconvertibility, government interference or expropriation, political violence and certain breach-of-contract exposure. Currency inconvertibility coverage addresses inability to convert or transfer under contract terms; it is not ordinary exchange-rate devaluation insurance.
kv: TRADE_EXPORT_CREDIT_AND_POLITICAL_RISK_CONTROL_MAP_2026-10-01.md, section “3. DFC covers investment political risk”

items.title: MIGA is a multilateral guarantee platform
items.sub: Trade, Export Credit and Political-Risk Control Map
items.text: The World Bank Group's Multilateral Investment Guarantee Agency covers eligible equity, debt and other financing against risks including currency inconvertibility and transfer restriction, expropriation, war and civil disturbance, breach of contract, and specified non-honoring of government or state-owned-enterprise obligations. MIGA can also share risk with donor or IDA facilities. Under its MIGA Guarantee Facility, IDA resources can provide shared first-loss or risk participation, with disbursement to MIGA only after a beneficiary call and MIGA claim determination under the contract. Donor announcement, facility allocation, MIGA issuance, covered event and claim payment must stay separate.
kv: TRADE_EXPORT_CREDIT_AND_POLITICAL_RISK_CONTROL_MAP_2026-10-01.md, section “4. MIGA is a multilateral guarantee platform”

items.title: Sanctions law is an external permission gate
items.sub: Trade, Export Credit and Political-Risk Control Map
items.text: OFAC states that insurers, reinsurers, brokers and agents are responsible for sanctions compliance throughout their involvement. A policy should not be read as permission to provide a prohibited service or make a prohibited claim payment. Coverage wording, the status of parties and activity at loss, blocking rules, general licenses and any specific license determine whether payment can proceed.
kv: TRADE_EXPORT_CREDIT_AND_POLITICAL_RISK_CONTROL_MAP_2026-10-01.md, section “5. Sanctions law is an external permission gate”

items.title: Public support can mobilize private finance without replacing it
items.sub: Trade, Export Credit and Political-Risk Control Map
items.text: An insured receivable may enter a lender's borrowing base; a sovereign or multilateral guarantee may improve project financeability; reinsurance or risk participation may expand the public institution's capacity. These are credit-channel effects. They do not prove shipment, investment, additionality, development impact or loss payment. Agricultural export guarantees such as USDA's GSM-102 belong in this trade-finance circuit, not in the crop-insurance indemnity chain: they support payment on eligible export credit rather than farm yield loss.
kv: TRADE_EXPORT_CREDIT_AND_POLITICAL_RISK_CONTROL_MAP_2026-10-01.md, section “6. Public support can mobilize private finance without replacing it”

catalog_context.title: How insurers invest trillions, move risk and share losses with government
catalog_context.answer: U.S. insurance runs through many separate regulators, very large insurer balance sheets, reinsurance and public loss programs that together work as one system. Each authority, company, contract and payment still keeps its own legal identity and timing.
